svg.title: Snapp final logo, Slip S direction
svg.desc: The final Snapp wordmark built from monoline geometry where the s is the Slip mark, shown on ink, paper and volt, in one color, as app icons, favicons, an avatar, in the snap button, and with its construction grid.
svg.text: Primary wordmark: paper on ink, with the release arc in volt
Two 270° arcs, radius 9, stroke 7, flat caps
The gap is the snap: 4 units, 7 when small
Top arc: preparation, in paper or ink
Bottom arc: release, in volt on ink only
Clear space: one bowl height on every side
Construction grid: x-height 36, stroke 7, bowls radius 18, arch radius 13
